environment: Windows x64, same machine, .NET 10 Release, sequential isolated processes
scope: In-process Core and actual Host request pipeline; excludes network, browser rendering and printer hardware

workloads.description: 100 repeated CPCL rows with explicit en-US yyyy-MM-dd formatting
800x600 ESC/POS Raster page, exactly 8 Code128 + 2 QR, one bundle request
25 distinct records, 400x120 page and one Code128 each, ESC/POS Raster + PDF + SVG

correctness: Every operation is validated; deterministic Core output byte equality; bundle image count 10; batch completed=25, failed=0 and 25 PDF/25 SVG entries. Exceptions, skipped workloads or missing samples fail.
metrics: operations per second from measured elapsed time
GC total allocated bytes per operation
relativeGate: Same harness SHA256, runtime, OS, architecture and processor count. Candidate median <= baseline*1.20 + 1ms; allocation <= baseline*1.10 + 64KiB. Also require every absolute gate. Do not compare different API paths as before/after.
approvalRule: Requires explicit user approval of this exact contract SHA256 before formal acceptance; diagnostics alone do not grant PASS. Never tune thresholds after viewing measurements.
